title: Generation 2 Stage 3 Attempt 2 gate criteria — Gate 3 development admissibility under the RA1 risk architecture, evaluation methods fixed before results
declaration_note: Attempt 2 inherits Attempt 1's Gate 3 criteria wherever they remain measurable as written. The thresholds, predicates, undefined-case handling and treatment of NOT_EVALUABLE are carried over unchanged, so a reader comparing SE100-CFG-3102 with this file sees a bounded set of differences and can check that each one is declared here. Exactly one measurement basis changes, and it changes because the RA1 risk architecture introduces an event Attempt 1's strategy could not produce: a sale that reduces a position without closing it. The frozen Portfolio records a closed round trip only when a sale takes the position to zero, so a trimmed position's realized proceeds are never attributed to any trade. That is G2A2-CONFLICT-18 below, it was established by measurement against the frozen module before this file was written, and it is resolved by a strict generalisation of the sealed trade definition rather than by editing anything.
adaptation_disclosure_carried: This file is part of an attempt whose pre-registration was written after Attempt 1's development results were known. The full disclosure text is carried verbatim in SE100-CFG-3103 field adaptation_disclosure_verbatim and in every downstream artifact listed in its adaptation_disclosure_carriage_requirement. It is not restated here in paraphrase, because a paraphrased disclosure is a weakened disclosure.

relationship_to_generation_1_criteria.note: This row describes the relationship to Generation 1 and is identical to the row in SE100-CFG-3102. Attempt 2 changes no threshold either. The Attempt 2 change is a measurement basis, not a threshold, and it is described in the next block.

relationship_to_attempt_1_criteria.predicates_changed: No relation and no threshold changed. Six of the seven predicate strings are character-identical to SE100-CFG-3102's; the seventh differs by one operand name and is recorded in full below, because 'none' would have been a claim the file itself contradicts.

predicate_operand_renamed.S3-C4: closed_trades >= 30 becomes closed_episodes >= 30. The relation and the threshold 30 are unchanged; only the name of the counted object changes, so that the predicate names the basis declared in G2A2-CONFLICT-18 instead of a basis this attempt does not use.
predicate_operand_renamed.why_this_cannot_change_a_verdict: A closed episode and a closed Portfolio.Trade are the same event — the moment a position returns to zero — so the two counts are equal on every run. The episode ledger changes what P&L is attributed to that event, never when the event occurs. S3-C4 counting_identity states this and the evaluator asserts the two counts equal at run time rather than assuming it.
predicate_operand_renamed.all_other_conditions: S3-C1, S3-C2, S3-C3, S3-C5, S3-C6 and S3-C7 carry predicate strings character-identical to SE100-CFG-3102's. Where a condition's measurement basis changed but its predicate string did not — S3-C3, S3-C5 and S3-C6 — the predicate was already written in terms of a quantity name that is basis-neutral, and the basis is fixed by the measurement block above it.

relationship_to_attempt_1_criteria.single_cause: All four changes have one cause and one resolution: the episode ledger of G2A2-CONFLICT-18. No condition is redefined for any other reason, and no condition is redefined in a direction that makes it easier to satisfy.
relationship_to_attempt_1_criteria.why_C1_C2_C7_are_untouched: S3-C1 and S3-C2 are measured on the engine's own equity curve, which is exact whether or not a position was trimmed — the probe that established G2A2-CONFLICT-18 confirmed the cash ledger reconciles to the true episode result even when the recorded trade does not. S3-C7 reads only the sign of each neighbour's equity-curve total return, so it inherits that exactness.
relationship_to_attempt_1_criteria.reduction_property: The episode ledger is a strict generalisation, not a replacement: for any episode containing exactly one sale leg it produces the same entry cash, exit cash, dividends and P&L as the frozen Portfolio.Trade. Attempt 1's strategy produced only such episodes, so this basis would have reproduced Attempt 1's gate figures exactly. The property is asserted at evaluation time for every single-leg episode in every run rather than argued for here; see evaluation_integrity_rules.

frozen_gate_text_verbatim: This gate rejects obviously weak or fitted candidates before sealed evaluation. Pass only if, on development data after base costs: total return is positive; maximum drawdown is no worse than 15%; profit factor is at least 1.10; at least 30 closed trades exist, unless a lower-frequency protocol predeclared a longer evidence requirement before results; performance is not dependent on one trade: removing the single best trade leaves total return above 0%; no single instrument contributes more than 50% of total strategy profit for a multi-instrument strategy; reasonable neighboring parameter values do not reverse the sign of net return. Fail verdict: STRATEGY_REJECTED_IN_DEVELOPMENT.

conflicts_found.status: inherited from Generation 1 via Attempt 1, unchanged
conflicts_found.description: The frozen JSON companion for gate 3 carries five thresholds. The frozen Markdown carries seven conditions: the same five plus the profit-concentration condition and the neighbouring-parameter sign-stability condition.
conflicts_found.resolution: The Markdown is authoritative and more restrictive. All seven conditions are evaluated and all seven must pass.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Reported, not repaired. No frozen artifact is edited.

conflicts_found.status: inherited, and materially more load-bearing in Attempt 2 than in Attempt 1
conflicts_found.description: Gate 3 requires maximum drawdown no worse than 15%. Constitution section 5.1 puts the research shutdown at exactly 15% below the running high-water mark. The two thresholds are the same number.
conflicts_found.resolution: Any variant that trips the shutdown has by construction breached S3-C2, and its equity curve is flat from liquidation onward because entries are permanently blocked.
conflicts_found.attempt_2_note: See G2A2-CONFLICT-19. In Attempt 2 the relationship is no longer only a consequence of the selection rule: the de-risk ladder is an explicit mechanism whose declared purpose is to reduce exposure at 5, 8 and 10 percent drawdown, all three of which sit inside the 15 percent threshold S3-C2 measures. A MET verdict on S3-C2 is close to a restatement of the fact that the ladder ran.

conflicts_found.status: inherited from Attempt 1, carried forward, and further qualified by G2A2-CONFLICT-23
conflicts_found.description: S3-C5's Generation 1 measurement reconstructs equity sequentially over closed trades in exit order and is exact only because Generation 1 could hold at most one position. Generation 2 holds up to three at once, so trades overlap and the sequential reconstruction is no longer exact.
conflicts_found.resolution: The per-trade multiple is taken against the equity base that actually existed when the trade was entered: r[i] = 1 + pnl[i] / E_entry[i], with E_entry[i] the account equity at the close of the session immediately preceding that trade's entry fill, or starting equity if there is no such session. Carried into Attempt 2 unchanged in form, with pnl[i] now the episode P&L of G2A2-CONFLICT-18.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Inherited. Generation 1's method is not edited and its file is not touched.

conflicts_found.status: inherited from Attempt 1, carried forward, and further qualified by G2A2-CONFLICT-22
conflicts_found.description: S3-C7's Generation 1 implementation raises ConfigViolation unless exactly four robustness neighbours are supplied. A three-axis grid does not produce exactly four.
conflicts_found.resolution: The neighbour set is defined structurally — every variant differing from the representative in exactly one axis by exactly one step, on the orderings lookback 3 < 6 < 12, k 1 < 2 < 3, frequency MONTHLY < QUARTERLY — and the same sign-stability predicate is evaluated over that set. The rule is a function of the representative's grid position and is fixed before the representative is known.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Inherited unchanged. Generation 1's condition_7 is not modified and is not called.

conflicts_found.description: Generation 1 evaluated Gate 3 as a disjunction across six independently declared candidates. Attempt 2 declares one candidate whose parameterisation is fixed by a frozen return-blind selection rule over eighteen variants.
conflicts_found.resolution: The gate is evaluated on the single selected representative. The disjunction of constitution section 9 is over a candidate set of size one. Evaluating all eighteen and passing the stage if any one of them passes would be the multiplicity abuse the selection rule exists to prevent.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Inherited. The other seventeen variants are reported descriptively and are never used to reach a verdict.

conflicts_found.severity: material — this is the reason Attempt 2 needs its own criteria file at all
conflicts_found.description: Attempt 2's aggregate throttle (RA2-1) and de-risk ladder (RA2-4) both reduce an existing position without closing it. stockedge100.backtest.portfolio.Portfolio.apply_fill appends a Trade only when a sale takes the position to exactly zero; on a partial sale it rewrites the position's cost basis pro rata and appends nothing. The consequence is not that trimmed activity is merely omitted. When the position is later closed, the recorded Trade carries the REDUCED cost basis as entry_cash and only the final leg's proceeds as exit_cash, so the trim's proceeds are attributed to no trade at all and the recorded P&L can differ from the episode's true realized P&L in sign.
conflicts_found.established_by: Measurement against the frozen module before this file was written, not by reading its source. A buy of 1 unit at 100.00, a 50 percent trim at 120.00 and a final exit at 90.00 produced exactly one recorded Trade with entry_cash 50.000, exit_cash 45.00 and pnl -5.000, while the account's cash rose by 5.00. Recorded and true P&L had opposite signs. The same probe confirmed that with no trim the recorded Trade is exact.
conflicts_found.scope: S3-C3, S3-C4, S3-C5 and S3-C6 all read the trade list. S3-C1 and S3-C2 read the equity curve and are unaffected; the probe confirmed the cash ledger reconciles to the true result in the same case where the trade list does not. S3-C7 reads only equity-curve return signs and is unaffected.
conflicts_found.resolution: Attempt 2 evaluates the four trade-based conditions on an EPISODE LEDGER derived from the engine's own fill record. An episode is one entry fill in a symbol together with every subsequent sale of that symbol up to and including the sale that returns the position to zero. entry_cash is the total cash paid on the episode's entry, exit_cash the total cash received across all of its sale legs, dividends those credited to the symbol while the episode was open, and pnl = exit_cash + dividends - entry_cash. A closed episode is one that reached zero quantity; an episode still open on the final session is not closed and is not counted, exactly as S3-C4 already required of a trade.
conflicts_found.why_this_is_not_a_redefinition_of_conven: The episode ledger agrees with the frozen Portfolio.Trade on every episode that has exactly one sale leg — that is, on every episode Attempt 1 could produce. It is a strict generalisation whose only new content is where to attribute the proceeds of a sale the frozen module drops. It cannot make a condition easier to satisfy in the single-leg case because it is numerically identical there, and in the multi-leg case it replaces a figure that is demonstrably wrong rather than one that is merely inconvenient.
conflicts_found.not_repaired_upstream: portfolio.py is a frozen Generation 1 module and is not edited, not subclassed to change its recording, and not worked around by suppressing partial sales. Suppressing them was considered and rejected: at k=1 a ladder that may only close whole positions cannot express a step to 75 percent of normal sizing at all, so forbidding trims would silently convert the declared staged reduction into an all-or-nothing exit for a third of the grid.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Declared before any Attempt 2 variant is run. The episode ledger lives in the Attempt 2 evaluation module; no frozen module is touched.

conflicts_found.description: The de-risk ladder reduces exposure at 5, 8 and 10 percent drawdown from the equity high-water mark. Gate 3's S3-C2 asks whether maximum drawdown stayed at or below 15 percent, and the representative-selection rule independently requires zero research-shutdown events, which is the same 15 percent measured from the same high-water mark.
conflicts_found.consequence: A MET verdict on S3-C2 is close to mechanical for Attempt 2. It is produced by three overlapping devices — a ladder designed to fire below the threshold, a selection screen that discards anything reaching it, and the condition itself — and it is therefore very weak evidence that the rotation hypothesis is true. Attempt 1 already carried this caution through S3-CONFLICT-3's generation_2_note; the ladder strengthens it from a selection artefact to an engineered one.
conflicts_found.resolution: S3-C2 is evaluated unchanged, at the unchanged threshold, and a MET verdict is recorded with this note attached in the decision package so it is not read as independent confirmation. The condition is not dropped: a variant that breaches 15 percent despite the ladder has failed something the ladder was built to prevent, which is informative in the other direction.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Declared before results. No threshold or predicate changed.

conflicts_found.description: S3-C4 requires at least 30 closed trades. Attempt 2's risk architecture pushes the trade count in both directions at once and the net sign is not predictable before the run: the 8 percent per-position stop creates exits that Attempt 1 had no mechanism to generate, while the 50 percent aggregate ceiling, the volatility scalar, the ladder and the 10-session re-entry lockout all reduce the size and sometimes the existence of entries.
conflicts_found.consequence: Neither direction is a reason to move the floor. It is recorded here so that a FAIL on S3-C4 is read as what it is — a low-activity result under a restrictive risk architecture — rather than retrospectively attributed to whichever mechanism is convenient once the count is known.
conflicts_found.resolution: The floor of 30 stands. The lower-frequency exception is NOT invoked, and could not lower the floor in any case because it permits a longer evidence requirement rather than a smaller count. Episode counts are reported for all eighteen variants alongside the ladder and lockout counters, so the relationship between risk activity and trade count is visible in the record rather than asserted.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Declared before results. exception_invoked stays false.

conflicts_found.description: The Attempt 2 operating instruction names the verdict tokens STAGE_3_G2_ATTEMPT_2_STRATEGY_ADMITTED_IN_DEVELOPMENT and STAGE_3_G2_ATTEMPT_2_NO_CANDIDATE. A search of the repository before this file was written found neither string in any artifact other than SE100-CFG-3103, which was written in the same session and refers forward to this file. The project rule is that a verdict token comes from disk rather than from a prompt. Separately, neither token is the constitution's frozen fail_result for gate 3, which is STRATEGY_REJECTED_IN_DEVELOPMENT, and the fail token names the absence of an admissible candidate rather than the rejection of one.
conflicts_found.resolution: This file is the disk. Both tokens are sealed here, before any Attempt 2 strategy module runs and before any variant is evaluated, so neither can be shaped by an outcome. The constitutional fail_result is recorded alongside as the equivalent under the constitution's own naming and the decision package states both. This is the same resolution Attempt 1 recorded as G2-CONFLICT-12, applied to the tokens of this attempt.
conflicts_found.distinct_from_attempt_1_tokens: STAGE_3_G2_STRATEGY_ADMITTED_IN_DEVELOPMENT and STAGE_3_G2_NO_CANDIDATE belong to Attempt 1 and its verdict of FAIL — STAGE_3_G2_NO_CANDIDATE stands permanently. No Attempt 2 artifact emits either of Attempt 1's tokens, and no Attempt 1 artifact is edited to mention Attempt 2's.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Sealed here before results. No sealed Generation 1 or Attempt 1 derivation is edited to match.

conflicts_found.description: S3-C7 asks whether reasonable neighbouring parameter values reverse the sign of net return. All eighteen Attempt 2 variants share one risk architecture whose five constants are frozen by SE100-CFG-3103 and are explicitly not part of the grid. The neighbour set therefore varies lookback, k and rebalance frequency only.
conflicts_found.consequence: S3-C7 says nothing whatever about the robustness of the 50 percent ceiling, the 10 percent volatility target, the 8 percent stop, the 5/8/10 ladder or the 10-session lockout. Those five values have no neighbours by construction, so a MET verdict on S3-C7 must not be read as evidence that the risk architecture is insensitive to its own parameterisation.
conflicts_found.resolution: S3-C7 is evaluated unchanged over the rotation axes. The gap is disclosed rather than closed, because closing it would mean grid-searching the risk constants, which SE100-CFG-3103 forbids for the stated reason that searching them alongside the rotation parameters would be fitting to 2008 and 2020. An untested constant that was frozen in advance is a weaker claim than a tested one and a far stronger one than a tuned one.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Declared before results. No risk constant is varied, at this stage or any later one, without a new disclosed adaptation.

conflicts_found.description: G2-CONFLICT-6 defines the S3-C5 per-trade multiple as r[i] = 1 + pnl[i] / E_entry[i], where E_entry[i] is equity immediately before the entry fill. Under Attempt 2 an episode's exposure changes during its life: the ladder or the throttle may cut the position in half partway through, so the P&L in the numerator was earned at a position size the denominator's entry-time equity does not describe.
conflicts_found.consequence: The multiple remains well defined, deterministic and identical across reruns, but it is a weaker proxy for 'what this episode did to the portfolio' than it was in Attempt 1, where position size was constant for an episode's whole life.
conflicts_found.resolution: The basis is kept exactly as G2-CONFLICT-6 defines it, with pnl[i] taken from the episode ledger. It is not re-based on average exposure or on a time-weighted denominator, because inventing a new denominator after seeing that the old one is imperfect is precisely the kind of post-hoc measurement choice the pre-registration exists to prevent. Both removals still apply and both must still leave a positive value. The reconstructed return, the equity-curve return and the gap between them are all reported.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Declared before results. The Generation 1 and Attempt 1 methods are not edited.

conflicts_found.description: SE100-CFG-3103 declares this attempt's candidate as SE100-G2-S3-C2-ROTATION-RA1, index 2, rather than reusing Attempt 1's SE100-G2-S3-C1-ROTATION. Constitution section 9 makes a gate conjunctive within a candidate, so reusing the Attempt 1 candidate id would attach Attempt 1's permanent FAIL to the same candidate and make the conjunction unsatisfiable by construction.
conflicts_found.consequence: Generation 2 now has two declared candidates at Gate 3, of which the first is permanently rejected. The stage-level disjunction of section 9 is over a candidate set whose only live member is C2, so it does not widen the number of chances this generation gets — but it does mean the generation has now spent two Gate 3 evaluations on one hypothesis family, which is exactly the cumulative multiplicity the adaptation disclosure records.
conflicts_found.resolution: C2 is used. S3-C6's applicability is bound to C2 by name below so that the condition cannot be argued to apply to a different candidate than the one evaluated.
conflicts_found.action_taken: Declared before results. Attempt 1's candidate id, package and verdict are untouched.

verdict_token_derivation.pass_condition: The representative selected by the frozen return-blind rule in SE100-CFG-3103 satisfies EVERY hard condition of Gate 3 on its base-cost development run.
verdict_token_derivation.fail_condition: Either no representative exists, because every one of the eighteen variants recorded at least one research-shutdown event, or a representative exists and does not satisfy every hard condition.
verdict_token_derivation.conjunctive_note: Constitution section 9: gates are conjunctive; every hard condition must pass, and NOT_RUN, UNKNOWN, NOT_EVALUABLE, or missing evidence is not a pass. Conjunction applies WITHIN a candidate. Attempt 2 declares one live candidate, so the cross-candidate disjunction is over a set of size one — see G2-CONFLICT-15 and G2A2-CONFLICT-24.
verdict_token_derivation.token_naming_note: See G2A2-CONFLICT-21. The instruction's fail token names the absence of an admissible candidate; the constitution's names the rejection of one. They denote the same stage outcome and both are recorded in the decision package.
verdict_token_derivation.attempt_1_tokens_are_not_available_here: STAGE_3_G2_STRATEGY_ADMITTED_IN_DEVELOPMENT and STAGE_3_G2_NO_CANDIDATE belong to Attempt 1. No Attempt 2 artifact may emit either, and the Attempt 2 package builder asserts that the verdict token it writes is one of the two sealed above and is not either of Attempt 1's.
verdict_token_derivation.other_tokens_available: BLOCKED_BY_DATA, BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, INVALIDATED, NOT_RUN, per constitution section 10. Missing evidence may never be converted to PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE for convenience.
verdict_token_derivation.fail_is_a_deliverable: FAIL — STAGE_3_G2_ATTEMPT_2_NO_CANDIDATE is a legitimate and fully anticipated outcome. It is recorded, kept on disk, and does not license a nineteenth variant, a re-run with a different grid, a loosened risk constant, or a promotion of the runner-up. Per SE100-CFG-3103, it closes the attempt: there is no Attempt 3 without a further disclosed adaptation authorised in a later session.
verdict_token_derivation.neither_token_is_a_stage_verdict_for_any: These two tokens belong to Generation 2 Stage 3 Attempt 2 alone. No artifact at any other stage, and no artifact of any other attempt, may emit either.

conditions.attempt_2_status: unchanged from Attempt 1 in threshold, predicate and measurement basis
conditions.measurement: total_return over the representative's base run, from stockedge100.backtest.metrics.total_return on the engine equity curve: final equity / starting equity - 1, exact Decimal.
conditions.costs: base cost model, all costs already charged inside the equity curve
conditions.not_evaluable_treatment: An equity curve with fewer than two points is NOT_EVALUABLE and fails.
conditions.attempt_2_note: Unaffected by G2A2-CONFLICT-18: the equity curve reflects every cash movement including partial sales, and the probe confirmed the ledger reconciles exactly in the case where the trade list does not. See also SC-6 in SE100-CFG-3103 — the risk architecture can only reduce exposure, so a FAIL here is a predictable consequence of the architecture rather than a new fact about the rotation signal, and must be reported as such.

conditions.required_verbatim: maximum drawdown is no worse than 15%
conditions.attempt_2_status: unchanged from Attempt 1 in threshold, predicate and measurement basis
conditions.measurement: max_drawdown from stockedge100.backtest.metrics: the largest peak-to-trough decline of the daily closing equity curve, expressed as a non-negative fraction of the running peak. Session-close granularity; the project holds no intraday data and none is imputed.
conditions.not_evaluable_treatment: An equity curve with fewer than two points is NOT_EVALUABLE and fails, on the same guard as S3-C1. Otherwise this condition is always evaluable: a run that never declined has a maximum drawdown of exactly zero, which is a measured value and not absent evidence. Attempt 1's file left this implicit; it is stated here because the ladder makes the drawdown path an engineered quantity rather than an incidental one, and an unstated assumption cannot be checked.
conditions.interaction: See S3-CONFLICT-3 and G2A2-CONFLICT-19. A MET verdict here is produced by three overlapping devices and is not independent evidence about the hypothesis. A NOT_MET verdict, by contrast, is informative: it means the ladder failed at the job it was added to do.

conditions.attempt_2_status: threshold and predicate unchanged; measurement basis generalised to the episode ledger — see G2A2-CONFLICT-18
conditions.measurement: Gross profit divided by gross loss over CLOSED EPISODES, where an episode's P&L is exit_cash plus dividends received while held minus entry_cash, with both legs' costs already inside those cash figures, and exit_cash is summed across every sale leg of the episode rather than only the leg that closed it. On any episode with exactly one sale leg this is numerically identical to stockedge100.backtest.metrics.profit_factor over Portfolio.trades.

undefined_cases.no_closed_episodes: profit_factor is null. Recorded as NOT_EVALUABLE and the condition FAILS. It is not passed by default and not marked not-applicable.
undefined_cases.no_losing_episodes: profit_factor is null because gross loss is zero. If closed episodes exist and gross profit is positive, this is recorded as UNDEFINED_NO_LOSSES_TREATED_AS_MET, with the raw null preserved in the evidence rather than replaced by a number. The sealed cost model requires profit factor undefined when there are no losses to be reported as null, never as infinity.

conditions.attempt_2_note: The frozen metrics function is not modified and is still called for the reconciliation figure. Both numbers are reported: profit factor over the episode ledger, which gates, and profit factor over Portfolio.trades, which does not. Where they differ, the difference is the trimmed proceeds the frozen recorder drops, and its size is the measure of how much the risk architecture actually traded.

conditions.required_verbatim: at least 30 closed trades exist, unless a lower-frequency protocol predeclared a longer evidence requirement before results
conditions.attempt_2_status: threshold and predicate unchanged; measurement basis generalised to the episode ledger — see G2A2-CONFLICT-18
conditions.measurement: Count of closed episodes in the representative's base run. An episode is closed when a sale returns the position to zero. A position still open on the final session is not closed and is not counted; at k = 3 up to three positions may be open on the final session and none of them counts. A position that has been trimmed but not closed is still open and is not counted.
conditions.not_evaluable_treatment: This condition is always evaluable. A count is defined for every run, and a run with no closed episodes has a count of zero, which is a measured value that fails the predicate rather than absent evidence. There is consequently no NOT_EVALUABLE path here and no case in which a missing figure could be read as satisfying the floor. Stated explicitly, because G2A2-CONFLICT-20 makes a low count a live possibility for Attempt 2 in a way it was not for Attempt 1.
conditions.exception_note: No Attempt 2 variant invokes the lower-frequency exception. The exception permits a LONGER evidence requirement, not a smaller trade count, so it could not lower this floor in any case. Recorded explicitly and before results so that a quarterly variant cannot be argued into it once its count is known. See G2A2-CONFLICT-20 for the two opposing effects the risk architecture has on this count, and SC-1 in SE100-CFG-3103 for the structural risk that a low-turnover quarterly k=1 variant falls short of 30.
conditions.counting_identity: A closed episode and a closed Portfolio.Trade are the same event: both are the moment a position returns to zero. The episode ledger changes what P&L is attributed to that event, not when the event occurs, so this count is identical to the count over Portfolio.trades. It is asserted equal at evaluation time rather than assumed.

conditions.required_verbatim: performance is not dependent on one trade: removing the single best trade leaves total return above 0%
conditions.attempt_2_status: REDEFINED for Generation 2 by G2-CONFLICT-6, carried into Attempt 2 with the episode-ledger P&L of G2A2-CONFLICT-18 and the qualification of G2A2-CONFLICT-23

measurement.basis: Closed episodes only. Each episode's multiple is taken against the equity that actually existed when that episode was entered, which is well defined whether or not other positions were open at the time and whether or not the position was later trimmed.
procedure: For the i-th closed episode, E_entry[i] = account equity at the CLOSE of the session immediately preceding that episode's entry fill, read from the engine's own equity curve. If the entry fill is on the first session of the run, E_entry[i] = starting equity = 100.00.
Per-episode equity multiple r[i] = 1 + pnl[i] / E_entry[i], with pnl[i] the episode P&L defined in S3-C3.
Reconstructed total return = product of all r[i], minus 1.
Best-episode-removed return = product of r[i] for i not equal to j, minus 1.
measurement.which_trade_is_removed: Two removals are computed and BOTH must leave a positive return. j1 is the episode with the largest equity multiple r[i]. j2 is the episode with the largest absolute P&L pnl[i]. These usually coincide and need not. Requiring both is the stricter reading, carried over unchanged from Generation 1 and Attempt 1, and it is fixed here so the stricter or looser reading cannot be chosen after seeing which one the representative survives.
measurement.tie_handling: If several episodes tie on the maximum, the earliest by index is removed. Carried over from Generation 1's max(..., key=(value, -index)) tiebreak so that the removal is deterministic.
measurement.relation_to_headline_return: The reconstruction is NOT expected to equal the equity-curve total return, and no attempt is made to make it equal. Concurrent positions mean the products do not telescope; dividends credited outside an episode and positions still open on the final session also contribute; and under Attempt 2 the exposure scalar changes within an episode's life. Both figures are reported side by side, together with their difference, and the condition is evaluated on the reconstruction, whose purpose is to be a like-for-like comparison against the same reconstruction with one episode removed.
measurement.disclosure_requirement: The Attempt 2 report states the reconstructed return, the equity-curve return, and the gap between them explicitly. A material gap is a limitation to disclose, not a defect to reconcile.

conditions.not_evaluable_treatment: Fewer than two closed episodes is NOT_EVALUABLE and fails; a result that is one episode is the exact dependence this condition tests for.
conditions.implementation: The Attempt 2 gate module. Generation 1's stockedge100.strategies.gate.condition_5 and Attempt 1's stockedge100.strategies.g2_gate are not called for Attempt 2 and neither is modified.

conditions.required_verbatim: no single instrument contributes more than 50% of total strategy profit for a multi-instrument strategy
conditions.attempt_2_status: predicate unchanged; measurement basis generalised to the episode ledger — see G2A2-CONFLICT-18
conditions.measurement: For each instrument, contribution = sum of pnl over that instrument's closed EPISODES, divided by the sum of pnl over all closed episodes. Evaluated only when total closed-episode P&L is strictly positive; when total P&L is zero or negative the share is not a meaningful proportion and the case is recorded as NOT_EVALUABLE — which is moot, because S3-C1 has already failed such a candidate.
conditions.why_the_basis_matters_here: This is the condition G2A2-CONFLICT-18 distorts most. Attribution is a ratio of one symbol's P&L to the total, so dropping a trim's proceeds corrupts both the numerator and the denominator, and the probe showed the dropped amount can exceed the retained one and reverse its sign. Computing the ratio over episodes is what makes the answer a fact about the strategy rather than about which positions happened to be trimmed.

scope_interpretation.rationale: Applicability is decided by the DECLARED universe, never by the realized symbol count. A candidate that declares one instrument cannot have a concentration problem the condition could detect, so it is NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_CONDITION_TEXT. A candidate that declares many and then trades one is exactly the case this condition exists to catch, so it remains applicable and fails.
scope_interpretation.why_it_always_applies: Attempt 2's declared universe is the full 34-member frozen list at every rebalance, so the strategy is multi-instrument by declaration regardless of how many symbols it turns out to trade. Deciding applicability from the realized count would let a candidate that collapsed onto one symbol escape the condition precisely when it is most informative.
scope_interpretation.single_instrument_treatment: Not reachable in Attempt 2. Retained in the schema so this file remains comparable to SE100-CFG-3102 and SE100-CFG-3002.
scope_interpretation.attempt_2_significance: This is the condition that tests the claim in the charter's section 2. Generation 1's validated candidate put 100% of its profit into SPY. If Attempt 2's representative does the same, this condition fails and the stage fails, which is the correct outcome: a rotation strategy that never rotates has not demonstrated the thing Generation 2 exists to test. The 50 percent aggregate exposure ceiling does not change this — it scales every position down together and cannot make a concentrated portfolio diversified.

conditions.required_verbatim: reasonable neighboring parameter values do not reverse the sign of net return
conditions.attempt_2_status: REDEFINED for Generation 2 by G2-CONFLICT-7, carried into Attempt 2 unchanged, and qualified by G2A2-CONFLICT-22

measurement.neighbour_definition: Every variant in the eighteen-variant Attempt 2 grid that differs from the representative in exactly one axis by exactly one step.
measurement.one_step_note: A step is to an adjacent value in the ordering above. From lookback 3 the only neighbour is 6, not 12. From k = 2 both 1 and 3 are neighbours. The frequency axis has two values, so its single neighbour is always the other one.
measurement.neighbour_count: 3 when the representative is at an endpoint of both the lookback and the k axis; 5 when it is interior on both; 4 otherwise. The count is a function of the representative's grid position and is not chosen.
measurement.no_new_runs: Every neighbour is already a declared member of the Attempt 2 grid and is already run under the same window, the same base cost model, the same frozen risk architecture and the research shutdown enforced. This condition creates no new parameterisation and no new run.
measurement.risk_constants_have_no_neighbours: The five RA1 constants are identical across all eighteen variants and are not gridded, so no neighbour differs from the representative in any risk parameter. See G2A2-CONFLICT-22: this condition is silent about the robustness of the risk architecture and a MET verdict must not be read as covering it.
measurement.what_is_read: Each neighbour's base-run equity-curve total return and its sign. Nothing else about a neighbour enters this condition.

conditions.predicate: sign(neighbour total_return) == sign(representative total_return) for EVERY neighbour, where sign is positive, negative, or zero and zero matches nothing
conditions.selection_prohibition: Neighbour runs are read for the sign of net return and nothing else. No neighbour is ever promoted to representative, and the representative's parameterisation is never revised because a neighbour did better. Doing so would be a material change under constitution section 11 and would create a new candidate restarting at Gate 3. It would also destroy the return-blind property of the selection rule, since the promotion would be driven by a return.
conditions.not_evaluable_treatment: A neighbour that fails to run is NOT_RUN, which is not a pass; the condition fails.
conditions.implementation: The Attempt 2 gate module. Generation 1's condition_7 raises ConfigViolation on a neighbour count other than four and is not called; it is not modified. Attempt 1's g2_gate is not called and is not modified.

reported_but_not_gating: The representative's stress run, in full. The stress cost assumption gates nothing at Gate 3, exactly as in Generation 1 and Attempt 1, and its figures are reported so a later gate reads them from evidence rather than re-deriving them.
All eighteen variants' return, maximum drawdown, profit factor, closed episode count, and shutdown event count, for both runs. Descriptive record only.

The Attempt 2 risk-architecture counters, for all eighteen variants and both runs: de-risk ladder activations by band, re-entry lockout triggers, aggregate-throttle trim events, per-position stop exits, and the maximum gross exposure fraction observed at any session. Required by the operating instruction's reporting section. None of them gates anything, and no threshold anywhere in this file is expressed in terms of them.

The reconciliation between the episode ledger and Portfolio.trades: episode count, trade count, the per-symbol P&L difference, and the total trimmed proceeds the frozen recorder attributes to no trade. Descriptive, and the direct evidence for G2A2-CONFLICT-18.
CAGR, annualised volatility, Sharpe ratio at a 0.00% risk-free rate, exposure fraction, win rate, average win, average loss, longest flat streak, distinct symbols traded, and per-symbol contribution.

SPY total return and SPY tradable buy-and-hold over the representative's own window, with the research shutdown both enforced and disabled, the latter explicitly labelled a benchmark reference account; the cash benchmark at 0.00% annual; and the do-nothing benchmark.

The comparison of Attempt 2 shutdown-trigger dates against Attempt 1's, required by the operating instruction whether or not the attempt passes. Descriptive; it gates nothing and cannot change a condition verdict.

Constitution section 4 requires better risk-adjusted performance than cash for a strategy to pass overall, and beating SPY is not mandatory where drawdown is materially reduced. Neither is among the seven hard conditions of Gate 3, so neither gates this stage.
evaluation_integrity_rules: Conditions are evaluated by a program that reads the engine's own outputs. No condition verdict is typed by hand into a report.
Every condition verdict is one of MET, NOT_MET, NOT_EVALUABLE, or NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_CONDITION_TEXT. There is no fifth value and no borderline value.
The candidate's admissibility is the conjunction of its applicable conditions. NOT_EVALUABLE never counts as MET.
Thresholds are compared as exact Decimals. No comparison is made in floating point, and no result is rounded before comparison.
The evidence file records the measured value alongside every verdict, so a reader can recompute the comparison without rerunning the engine.

The representative is selected before any condition is evaluated, by the return-blind rule in SE100-CFG-3103. Condition evaluation cannot feed back into selection, because selection has already happened and is not repeated.
If the representative fails any condition, the stage fails. No other variant is evaluated against the gate.

The episode ledger is reconciled against the frozen Portfolio.trades on every run, not only on the representative's. For every episode with exactly one sale leg, entry_cash, exit_cash, dividends and pnl are asserted equal to the corresponding Trade, and the closed episode count is asserted equal to the closed trade count. A failure of either assertion halts evaluation rather than being reported as a discrepancy, because it would mean the generalisation of G2A2-CONFLICT-18 is not the generalisation this file declares.

That reconciliation must not be allowed to pass vacuously. The evaluator asserts that the number of single-leg episodes compared is greater than zero before asserting that they agree, and reports the compared count alongside the mismatch count. A run in which no episode closed would otherwise satisfy the reconciliation by having nothing to reconcile.

The gate threshold seal check runs before any condition is evaluated: the five frozen thresholds, the S3-C6 predicate text and the S3-C4 exception flag are asserted unchanged against the constitution. A file that has drifted from the seal cannot be used to evaluate anything, whatever its conditions say.

windows.enforcement: ResearchWindow raises WindowViolation on any session outside the development window, MarketView raises LookAheadError on any read past the decision session, and stockedge100.strategies.g2_window_guard adds the three Generation 2 checks sealed in STAGE_1_G2_PARTITION_LOCK.md section 4. Attempt 2 reuses that guard unmodified rather than re-deriving its bounds. All are structural; none depends on a strategy behaving well.
windows.disclosed_limitation_reference: Any Generation 2 report that references the validation window reproduces the disclosure text of STAGE_1_G2_PARTITION_LOCK.md section 2 verbatim. This stage does not read the validation window at all.
windows.generation_2_holdout: 2026-08-01 to 2028-07-31. Never read, by this stage or any code it runs, and not readable before that period exists in real calendar time.
